tagline: Create and track Jira issues directly from Slack conversations
metaTitle: Slack Jira Integration: Create and Update Issues from Slack
metaDescription: Turn Slack messages into Jira issues and run incidents from a channel without the noise. GAIA answers Jira questions in Slack. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering teams report bugs and discuss incidents in Slack, but track them in Jira. Because of that gap, important issues get reported in chat but never logged, and ticket updates don't reach the team where they're already collaborating.

GAIA turns Slack into a full-featured Jira interface. Team members create issues from messages with an emoji reaction. Status updates are posted to the right channels. Engineers can query and update issues without leaving the conversation. The result is a tighter feedback loop between what the team discovers and what gets tracked.

useCases.title: Create Jira issues from Slack messages
useCases.description: React to any message with a designated emoji or GAIA command and the message becomes an issue without leaving the chat. GAIA formats the content, assigns the right project, and posts the issue link back into the conversation.

useCases.title: Incident management from a channel
useCases.description: When an incident is discussed in a channel, GAIA creates a tracking issue, sets priority based on severity language in the conversation, and links the issue to the thread for shared context.

useCases.title: Real-time status updates in channels
useCases.description: Issue transitions in Jira post real-time updates to designated channels so the team knows when bugs are assigned, in progress, or resolved without checking manually.

useCases.title: Query Jira from chat
useCases.description: Ask GAIA in Slack for the status of specific issues, sprint progress, or open bugs in a project. GAIA runs the query and returns a formatted summary so the team gets answers without switching apps.

useCases.title: On-call alert to incident issue
useCases.description: When an on-call alert fires in a channel, GAIA creates an incident issue automatically with the alert details, assigns it to the on-call engineer, and starts tracking time to resolution.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Add GAIA to your Slack workspace and authorize your Jira account. Configure which channels correspond to which projects.

howItWorks.step: Configure issue creation and notification rules
howItWorks.description: Choose your issue creation triggers (emoji, command, or keyword detection) and specify which status transitions should notify which channels.

howItWorks.step: Work in the channel, track in the project automatically
howItWorks.description: Team members interact with issues from chat while GAIA keeps both systems synchronized. Engineering context stays with the issues while team communication stays in the channels.

faqs.question: Can GAIA update issue fields from Slack without opening Jira?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in the channel to change assignee, update priority, add a comment, change status, or set a due date on any issue. GAIA confirms each update in the thread.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with the sprint and board structure?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create issues in specific sprints, move issues between sprints, and report on sprint progress from chat. You can also ask GAIA to show what's in the current sprint for any project.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle status notifications without creating too much noise in the channels?
faqs.answer: GAIA applies intelligent filtering. You configure exactly which events notify which channels. Most teams start with just high-priority status changes and add more events as needed.
